models.title: Church Launch
models.summary: A prepared leadership team gathers people around a shared vision and forms a visible new congregation with the support of a sending church or network.
models.bestSuitedFor: A pioneer and launch team with a defined community, public-launch vision, and sending relationship.
models.whatStrengthensIt: Prayer, assessment, coaching, launch planning, financial preparation, and accountable leadership.

models.title: Missional Church
models.summary: Leaders enter the everyday life of a community, build genuine relationships, and make disciples where people already live and gather.
models.bestSuitedFor: Communities where relational presence and patient disciple-making should precede a formal public gathering.
models.whatStrengthensIt: Consistent presence, hospitality, spiritual rhythms, local listening, and leaders who recognize when community becomes church.

models.title: Micro Church
models.summary: A simple expression of church gathers around mission, discipleship, worship, and shared life without depending on a large weekly service.
models.bestSuitedFor: Homes, neighborhoods, workplaces, campuses, and other contexts where smaller reproducible communities can flourish.
models.whatStrengthensIt: Simple practices, shared participation, local leadership development, relational accountability, and a clear path toward reproduction.

models.title: Multi-Community Church
models.summary: One established church forms distinct communities in different neighborhoods, cultures, or ministry contexts while sharing identity and support.
models.bestSuitedFor: An established church prepared to extend its mission through multiple contextualized communities rather than one centralized gathering.
models.whatStrengthensIt: Shared vision, distributed leadership, clear decision rights, common resources, and meaningful local expression.

models.title: Church Collective
models.summary: Several emerging church expressions grow within a shared relational and organizational covering as leaders develop toward maturity.
models.bestSuitedFor: A network of pioneers or developing communities that benefit from common covering without becoming identical expressions.
models.whatStrengthensIt: Trusted relationships, coaching, theological alignment, shared accountability, adaptable support, and a clear process for releasing leaders.
